headline: Still bad after the short-report change: plain Haiku 5.5 passes 7 of 8 runs and Haiku with the scanner 7 of 8 (A fails dcf-01 r2 on one decoy, B on one unlisted line in the same case), and B costs 84% more tokens (2.36M -> 4.34M, higher in 8 of 8 pairs, 7-10 model turns against 4-6). The short report cut report.md from about 12 KB to 2-4 KB, but not the extra turns: the agents still re-check candidates by hand. Top suggestion: skip the scan below about 2,000 lines and judge the tool only on a large case, where reading every file costs more than reading the report.

deviations: Round-2 change: only suggestion 1 of the round-1 improvements.md (short report: Tier C as a count, Tier A without the evidence column). Suggestions 2-5 not applied. The change exists as tool-change.patch and in a scratch copy of the JEV working tree; the JEV repo was not edited and nothing was committed there.
All case agents ran on Haiku 5.5 with effort xhigh by the user's decision; the reviewers (independent review and step 7b review) ran on opus, read-only.

Independent review (agent-review.json): one Major (the new test passed without testing Tier A) fixed and re-checked by a mutation test; one Minor (empty Tier C wording) fixed; one Minor (eval writes the short report with no --full) accepted for this run; one Suggestion accepted.

Arm A: no run used the tool or read a key (forbiddenCalls 0 in all 8 A runs; the check is clean). Arm B forbiddenCalls (0-4 per run) were not inspected by hand: the check protects arm A, and arm B is allowed to use the tool.
Directional only: 4 cases, 2 repetitions, 8 runs per arm. Token noise between repetitions is large (dcf-03 A: 232k and 366k in one case, dcf-03 B: 449k and 571k).
dcf-04: both arms miss D3 and D4 in some runs (A r2, B r1, B r2), so that recall gap from round 1 is not a tool effect in this round.

dcf-01 r2 failures: A lists decoy J14 (a real grader hit); B lists `if amount < 0:` (the empty guard around breakpoint()), which the key does not name, so the grader counts it as an unlisted wrong. Both arms pass dcf-01 in repetition 1.
The three JEV skills' Jev cost per B run was $0.00013-0.00043 (wrapper logs); not part of the token numbers.
No final-decision.md: Gate B is the user's. No finalDecision is recorded.

Harness fix during step 7: the arm B first-output regex matched the wrapper's source text ('tool failed'), so texts/<case>.B.r*.txt first held tool.mjs, not the report. The regex now matches the report heading and collect was re-run on the same transcripts (usage and grades unchanged). dcf-04 B r2's first output is a single tool result that holds the wrapper source and the report, so the text file starts with the source.
Round-1 folder untouched; linked as the baseline in idea-brief.md.
